entries.06714a97c790f5a4: This is a single-segment business conducted by a group consisting of the company, three consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate. As a cloud-based BPO service company for automotive-related businesses aiming to provide an “IT platform” that fuses financial technology and information technology, it provides automotive-related businesses with a system for evaluating and calculating the value of used vehicles, built on information centered on used car market prices. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,733 million.
entries.2d60f5480671f2e2: It provides services and systems including: the ASP service “Shisurokketto,” which packages functions useful to auto finance operators, led by auto leasing companies; the sales support system for new-car dealers “CA Doctor,” developed by combining the company’s solutions; the batch calculation service “CAV Monitor,” which makes risk visible by comparing residual values set in the past with current vehicle values; and a system that provides finance quote preparation over a network that takes into account the future value (residual value) of vehicles. Consolidated subsidiary Inspiration Co., Ltd. operates a solution business for automobile dealerships.
entries.4d810c3311e7ffa1: This is a single-segment business conducted by a group consisting of the company, three consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate.
entries.532244ff90fad0e1: The company provides “RV Doctor,” an automotive asset valuation system independently developed by the group, which performs statistical analysis of past used car sales results to calculate the present value (market valuation) and future value (projected sale price) of automotive assets, and “PV Doctor,” a system that uses know-how for calculating future value to calculate the current standard vehicle value without arbitrary judgment.
entries.6f2732fb02441a98: A company that provides systems calculating the future value and present value of automobiles to automotive finance companies and automobile sales companies.
entries.75aebc5d73256eb6: It provides the “Vehicle Catalog Database,” a hierarchical database of text-based car catalogs that includes information such as manufacturer and dealer option prices and taxes.
